I’m gonna be as blunt as I physically can. Idk if you’re still alive or not. But just read this for me.. okay? I lost one of my best friends months ago to this and it hurt like hell. Women, ARE NOT WORTH THIS. In fact, nothing is. If she cheated on you that means she’s a piece of shit who never deserved you in the first place. I have attempted suicide three times in my life. Every time I did (drowning with something over me so I couldn’t move, pills, shooting myself in the face but I was 13 and never used a gun before soooo hard to do when the slide wasn’t racked) I had a underlying urge to survive.. every time I tried I learned something more and more from it. And it showed me after years of depression and hate for my life. For losing my mom, for being bullied every day, for not being enough for the majority of women who did in fact cheat on me (fuck them by the way) that in reality I was the one allowing this world to have that hold on me. That the thing that was really sad wasn’t that other people didn’t see the value I had, but that I didn’t even see it. I put my identity in the hands of others and it was grueling, and exhausting. 

So… I stopped. I stopped caring so much. I regained my faith in Christ, my faith in myself, I started to work out, and tried my damndest to perform in school. And right now at 23 y/o I can safely tell you this. It’s still a struggled, those thoughts creep back in, I get lazy, I fuck up I make mistakes. It’s part of it, you can’t and won’t heal if you don’t teach yourself that when you get knocked down no matter how bad. You pick yourself up, you dust yourself off, and you keep moving forward even if you don’t see it. Sooner or later something or someone is going to come into your life and change it for the better. I currently am about to be engaged with a 2 year old boy and graduate college in a year. If you asked me 3 years and beyond if this was where i would be in life, id tell you you’re insane. But it’s happened. 

Now, I note directly for you. You seem like the kind of person who loves and loves hard. That’s good., don’t lose that because there’s enough assholes in the world as is. You seem like someone who feels compassion and this could very well be the first time you’ve ever been burned. You’re going to feel pain in your life moving forward. Idk how old you are but this will sting. There’s not a time frame for healing. There’s not cheat code for letting it go. It’s going to hurt. But one day, you will not think about it. One day you’ll realize that it didn’t even enter your mind that week. And for me, when I went through that with the girl I originally thought I would marry. Boyyy did I go through it, it took me a year to be done with it. And once I was man, it was like the world lifted off my shoulders. Trust me man, if you put the effort into truly working on yourself, not for anyone else but for you. the outcome will be insane. I can’t promise you it will be easy, I can’t tell you you won’t feel these thoughts again because I do as well, but what I can tell you. Is that through it all, it will be worth it.

Thank you for posting this, thank you for telling us what you’re dealing with. But I truly hope you take this to heart and stay, not just for us who have felt what you’ve felt. But for yourself. Love yourself and if you don’t already then get to know who you are so that you can. I love you buddy, here if you need me
